svg.title: Participant-grouped sEMG and acceleration classification
svg.desc: Five-band research figure. Forearm sensor origin, fixed original E1 class labels, matched classical and temporal unimodal methods, five participant-independent Development folds and OOF fusion-ready evidence. Schematics are conceptual, not predictive results.

g.text: Paired E1 sEMG and accelerometry · Classical baselines + CNN / TCN / BiGRU · Development-only comparisons
OOF class scores aligned by window
Methods schematic: trained model scores are not asserted here; Test people do not influence Development selection.
Independent participants → matched unimodal fits → per-person Development scores → fixed fusion comparator
